title: The instruments he plays: clarinet, saxophone, trumpet, bass
summary: He started on clarinet, moved through saxophones and trumpet, and became a bass player for the Eureka band after one lesson from Professor Delmore.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
